_note: Example manifest. All paths here are fake. Generate a real one with 'python main.py --discover <dicom root>', or copy this shape. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

<case id>.contrast_dirs: list of series folders, in the order they map onto contrast_pre, contrast_1, ... One folder holding a whole dynamic series is also fine: it gets split by acquisition number.
<case id>.t2_dir: optional single series folder for T2; omit it or run with --no-t2 to skip
